questions.text: Is there a works council? Who receives this notice?
What is the tool called, and who supplies it?
When do you plan to start?

What is the system's intended purpose, who is its provider, and which version is this, in relation to earlier versions?
Does the system interact with hardware or software that isn't part of it, including other AI systems? How?
Which versions of software or firmware does it use, and what do version updates require?

Which training methods and data sets were used: their provenance, scope and main characteristics, and how the data was obtained, selected, labelled and cleaned?
Which human oversight measures does the system need (Art. 14), and which technical measures help deployers interpret its outputs?
Are changes to the system and its performance determined in advance? If so, what are they, and how do you make sure it keeps meeting the requirements?

Which validation and testing procedures and data were used, and which metrics measure accuracy, robustness and potentially discriminatory impacts? Where are the dated and signed test logs and reports?
Which cybersecurity measures are in place?
What are the system's capabilities and limitations in performance, including its accuracy for the persons or groups it is used on and its expected accuracy overall?
Which unintended outcomes and sources of risk to health, safety and fundamental rights, and of discrimination, can be foreseen?
Which human oversight measures are in place, including the technical measures that help deployers interpret the outputs?
Which specifications apply to the input data, if any?
Which performance metrics do you use, and why are they appropriate for this system?
Describe the risk management system under Art. 9 in detail, or name the document that does.
Which relevant changes have you made to the system through its lifecycle?

Which harmonised standards published in the Official Journal do you apply, in full or in part? If none, how do you meet the requirements, and which other standards and technical specifications do you apply?
Once the EU declaration of conformity (Art. 47) is drawn up, where is its copy kept?
How do you evaluate the system's performance once it is on the market (Art. 72), and where is the post-market monitoring plan (Art. 72(3))?
What is your strategy for regulatory compliance, including conformity assessment and the management of changes to the system?
Which techniques, procedures and systematic actions do you use to design the system and to control and verify its design?
Which techniques, procedures and systematic actions do you use for development, quality control and quality assurance?
Which examination, test and validation procedures do you carry out before, during and after development, and how often?
Which technical specifications and standards do you apply, and where the harmonised standards don't cover every requirement, how do you meet it?
Which systems and procedures govern your data management, from acquisition and labelling to storage and retention?
Which document sets out your risk management system under Art. 9?
How do you set up, run and maintain post-market monitoring (Art. 72)?
What is your procedure for reporting a serious incident (Art. 73)?
How do you handle communication with authorities, notified bodies, other operators, customers and other interested parties?
Which systems and procedures keep records of all relevant documentation and information?
How do you manage resources, including security of supply?
Who in management and among other staff is responsible for each of these aspects?
Who establishes, implements and maintains the risk management system, and where is it documented?
How often is it reviewed and updated through the system's lifecycle?
Which known and reasonably foreseeable risks to health, safety or fundamental rights can the system pose when it is used as intended?
How do you estimate and evaluate the risks, under intended use and under reasonably foreseeable misuse?
How do you evaluate other risks from the data your post-market monitoring gathers (Art. 72)?
Which risk management measures address the risks you identified?
Why is the residual risk of each hazard, and the overall residual risk, acceptable?
How do design and development eliminate or reduce the risks, and which mitigation and control measures address those that can't be eliminated?
Which information (Art. 13) and, where appropriate, training do deployers get?
Which tests identify the most appropriate risk management measures and show that the system performs consistently for its intended purpose? Where are the results?
When during development is the system tested, and against which metrics and probabilistic thresholds, defined beforehand?
Is the system likely to have an adverse impact on people under 18 or other vulnerable groups? How have you considered this?
Was ist die Zweckbestimmung des Systems, wer ist sein Anbieter, und welche Version ist dies, im Verhältnis zu früheren Versionen?
Interagiert das System mit Hardware oder Software, die nicht Teil des Systems ist, auch mit anderen KI-Systemen? Wie?
Welche Versionen von Software oder Firmware verwendet es, und was setzen Aktualisierungen voraus?
In welchen Formen wird es in Verkehr gebracht oder in Betrieb genommen, zum Beispiel als Softwarepaket, zum Herunterladen oder als API?
Auf welcher Hardware soll es betrieben werden?
Ist es Bestandteil eines Produkts? Wenn ja, welche Fotografien oder Abbildungen zeigen die äußeren Merkmale, die Kennzeichnung und den inneren Aufbau des Produkts?
Wie ist die Benutzerschnittstelle, die dem Betreiber zur Verfügung steht, kurz beschrieben?
Wo finden sich die Betriebsanleitungen für den Betreiber?
Mit welchen Methoden und Schritten wurde das System entwickelt, einschließlich vortrainierter Systeme oder Instrumente Dritter, und wie wurden diese verwendet, integriert oder verändert?

Wie lauten die Entwurfsspezifikationen: die allgemeine Logik und die Algorithmen, die wichtigsten Entwurfsentscheidungen mit Gründen und Annahmen, was das System optimieren soll, die erwartete Ausgabe und ihre Qualität sowie Kompromisse zur Erfüllung der Anforderungen?

Welche Spezifikationen gelten gegebenenfalls für die Eingabedaten?
Welche Leistungskennzahlen verwenden Sie, und warum sind sie für dieses System geeignet?

Welche Techniken, Verfahren und systematischen Maßnahmen nutzen Sie für Entwicklung, Qualitätskontrolle und Qualitätssicherung?

document.label: DRAFT

sections.heading: The system
paragraphs: The company uses a tool bought from a vendor
The tool scores and ranks applicants
The tool was not modified

sections.heading: Its classification
paragraphs: Your classification: high-risk, Annex III point 4(a).
It lists the duty under Art. 9, which applies from 2 December 2027.

requirement.quote: A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems.

the identification and analysis of the known and the reasonably foreseeable risks that the high-risk AI system can pose to health, safety or fundamental rights when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose;
the estimation and evaluation of the risks that may emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose, and under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse;
the evaluation of other risks possibly arising, based on the analysis of data gathered from the post-market monitoring system referred to in Article 72;
the adoption of appropriate and targeted risk management measures designed to address the risks identified pursuant to point (a).

High-risk AI systems shall be tested for the purpose of identifying the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures. Testing shall ensure that high-risk AI systems perform consistently for their intended purpose and that they are in compliance with the requirements set out in this Section.

sections.heading: When and against what it is tested

requirement.quote: The testing of high-risk AI systems shall be performed, as appropriate, at any time throughout the development process, and, in any event, prior to their being placed on the market or put into service. Testing shall be carried out against prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds that are appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

When implementing the risk management system as provided for in paragraphs 1 to 7, providers shall give consideration to whether in view of its intended purpose the high-risk AI system is likely to have an adverse impact on persons under the age of 18 and, as appropriate, other vulnerable groups.
